ecr.title: Fan-out CVN-FO-3612 - change Rev A to Rev B (18 LC/APC uniboot duplex legs, legs 1.0 m, trunk 10.0 m with pulling grip, +2,000 pcs)
ecr.priority: High - row-level cabling layout for the Phase 2 data hall
ecr.reason: The Phase 2 data hall places the LC patch panels one rack away from the switches: the trunk grows to 10 m and is pulled through the overhead trays, so a pulling grip is needed. The new panels are duplex (18 LC duplex ports) and need 1 m legs for the cable management arms. Forecast increased.
ecr.agreed_effectivity: Samples and Lot 1 (PO lines 1.1 / 1.2, 1,000 pcs, material issued) delivered to Rev A0 / customer Rev A; Rev B0 / customer Rev B from Lot 2 (PO line 1.3) onwards.
attachments: CVN-DWG-3612 Rev B (fan-out outline and port map)

changes.title: Legs 36 x LC/APC simplex -> 18 x LC/APC uniboot duplex
changes.to: 18 duplex legs 3.0 mm round (2 fibres), LC/APC uniboot duplex
changes.lpc: Feasible - stocked uniboot kits (PP-LC-APC-DU) and 3.0 mm duplex leg cable. Not requested but required: the 36-port fan-out box (Ø 2.0 mm ports, 20 x 10 mm cross-section) cannot take 18 duplex legs of Ø 3.0 mm; a new box 80 x 26 x 12 mm (new mould, 4 weeks) is needed, which exceeds the R-11 envelope 65 x 22 x 12 mm - Corvane to confirm the panel slot. The Rev A0 boxes bought for Lots 2 / 3 become obsolete.
changes.cost: Approx. + USD 12 per pc full cost (uniboot kits, new fan-out box, duplex leg cable)
changes.schedule: New fan-out box 4 weeks - B0 from Lot 2; risk buy at ECR approval
changes.decision: Accepted - Corvane confirmed panel slot 82 x 28 x 14 mm

changes.title: Leg length 500 -> 1,000 mm
changes.reason: Cable management arms of the duplex panel
changes.lpc: Feasible - cutting length only (leg cable and fibre).
changes.cost: Approx. + USD 2.5 per pc full cost (leg cable, fibre)

changes.lpc: Feasible - pulling grip PP-PULL-M12x3 rated 300 N (LPC-QM-021 §4.6). Not requested but required: trunks longer than 5 m are shipped on a 300 mm reel (§11.10), 8 reels per carton instead of 10 coils.
changes.cost: Approx. + USD 16 per pc full cost (ribbon, jacket, pulling grip, reel, + 8 min cutting / grip / winding)
changes.zone: Sh1 B2, C4, D1, D5, E1, F1 / Sh2 D7, F1 / Sh3 E1, F2
